pokedexEntries.rb: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

pokedexEntries.ye: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration, it lost its sense of smell.

pokedexEntries.go: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

pokedexEntries.si: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

pokedexEntries.cr: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.

pokedexEntries.ru: From MUK’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this POKéMON’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.

pokedexEntries.sa: This POKéMON’s favorite food is anything that is repugnantly filthy. In dirty towns where people think nothing of throwing away litter on the streets, MUK are certain to gather.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

pokedexEntries.lg: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

pokedexEntries.em: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

pokedexEntries.mo: After recent environmental improvements, this Pokémon is now hardly seen at all. People speculate that it may go extinct at some point.

pokedexEntries.us: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

pokedexEntries.um: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they’ve long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.
